what: A small video box tilted -5° and sandwiched between big title lines is tied to scroll (scrub .25) and grows as it is Flip.fit into the full-width slot of the next section — it starts when the box center is at the screen center and ends when the target center is at the screen center. During the first 1/3, the tilt and the mouse tilt (max 20°, .5s power3.out) unwind to 0, leaving an upright big screen

options.target: Selector for the place it grows into — required. In the original it is the 16:9 cell in the next section
options.[data-fx-part=tilt]: Tilt panel (optional) — if absent, the element itself is tilted

use: Video …
note: Fires fx:grow while in progress (detail 0~1, reaches 1 at 1/3) — used to retract the badge (hover-sticker-burst). Re-measured when the window width changes

from.where: index.js Hero video box → showreel section (original hero_reel-wrap Flip.fit, start clamp(center center) · end center center · scrub .25, rotZ −5 · max-rotate 20, progress ×3)
